name: Palo Brunch Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict, Omelets & Mickey Waffles/Pancakes
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Brunch)
whyItWorks: Cooked fresh to order: custom aged-cheese omelets, poached eggs with smoked salmon on English muffins, and fluffy buttermilk pancakes/waffles.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for hollandaise on the side (contains lemon juice) on any Eggs Benedict, or order a custom omelet with aged Parmigiano/Swiss and plain waffles with maple syrup.
watchOuts: Lemon juice in hollandaise sauce (order on side or dry)
Skip seeded berry compote on waffles
